dataset.v: 五个数据集，包含人体器官与体模（phantom）数据
dataset.excerpt: We conduct experiments on five datasets containing human organ and phantom data. Details are listed in Table 1.

dataset.v: chest、jaw、foot、abdomen；chest 来自 LIDC-IDRI，其余来自 Open Scientific Visualization Datasets
dataset.excerpt: We evaluate our method using public datasets of human organ CTs [4,12], including chest, jaw, foot and abdomen. The chest data are from LIDC-IDRI dataset [4], and the rest are from Open Scientific Visualization Datasets [12].

dataset.v: 用 GE C-arm Medical System 扫描硅主动脉体模
dataset.excerpt: We collect a phantom dataset by scanning a silicon aortic phantom with GE C-arm Medical System.

dataset.k: 体模 ground truth CT 尺寸
dataset.excerpt: A 512×512×510 CT image is also generated with inbuilt algorithms as the ground truth.

acquisition.k: 人体器官投影生成方式
acquisition.v: 用断层工具箱 TIGRE 生成投影
acquisition.excerpt: Since these datasets only provide volumetric CT scans, we generate projections by a tomographic toolbox TIGRE [5].

acquisition.k: 人体器官投影视图数与噪声
acquisition.v: 在 180° 范围内采集 50 个投影，含 3% 噪声
acquisition.excerpt: In TIGRE [5], we capture 50 projections with 3% noise in the range of 180◦.

acquisition.k: 体模系统投影采集参数
acquisition.v: 582 张 500×500 透视投影；position primary angle 从 −103° 到 93°；position secondary angle 为 0°
acquisition.excerpt: This system captures 582 500×500 fluoroscopy projections with position primary angle from -103◦to 93◦and position secondary angle of 0◦.

acquisition.k: 体模实验实际使用投影数
acquisition.excerpt: We only use 50 projections for experiments.

training.excerpt: Our proposed method is implemented in PyTorch [17].

training.v: Adam 优化器，学习率从 1×10⁻³ 降至 1×10⁻⁴
training.excerpt: We use Adam optimizer with a learning rate that starts at 1 ×10−3 and steps down to 1 ×10−4.
The batch size is 2048 rays at each iteration.

training.v: 取决于 CT 数据大小；例如 128×128×128 chest CT 每条射线采样 192 个点
training.excerpt: The sampling quantity of each ray depends on the size of CT data. For example, we sample 192 points along each ray for the 128×128×128 chest CT.

training.v: 使用与 [14] 相同的超参数设置；更多超参数细节见补充材料
training.excerpt: We use the same hyper-parameter setting for hash encoder as [14]. More details of hyper-parameters can be found in the supplementary material.
All experiments are conducted on a single RTX 3090 GPU.

baselines.excerpt: FDK [7] is firstly chosen as a representative of analytical methods.

baselines.v: 鲁棒迭代重建算法，引用 [2]
baselines.excerpt: The second method SART[2] is a robust iterative reconstruction algorithm.

baselines.v: 带 total-variation 正则化的迭代方法，引用 [20]
baselines.excerpt: ASD-POCS[20] is another iterative method with a total-variation regularizer.

baselines.v: IntraTomo [28] 的 CBCT 变体，作为频率编码深度学习方法示例
baselines.excerpt: We implement a CBCT variant of IntraTomo [28], named IntraTomo3D, as an example of frequency-encoding deep learning methods.

baselines.k: baseline 是否重训及是否同设置

metrics.excerpt: We evaluate five methods quantitatively in terms of peak signal-to-noise ratio (PNSR) and structural similarity (SSIM) [25].

metrics.v: PSNR(dB) 统计评估伪影抑制性能；SSIM 衡量两信号间的感知差异；PSNR/SSIM 越高表示重建越准确
metrics.excerpt: PSNR (dB)statisticallyassessestheartifactsuppressionperformance,whileSSIMmea-sures the perceptual diﬀerence between two signals. Higher PNSR/SSIM values represent the accurate reconstruction and vice versa.

results.k: abdomen 数据集 PSNR 领先幅度
results.v: 比第二好的 SART 高 3.07 dB
results.excerpt: For example, the PSNR value of our method in the abdomen dataset is 3.07 dB higher than that of the second-best method SART.

results.v: 10-40 分钟内重建详细 CT 模型，与迭代方法相当
results.excerpt: method can reconstruct a detailed CT model within 10-40 minutes, which is comparable to iterative methods.

results.v: NAF 比频率编码深度学习方法 IntraTomo3D 快 3 倍
results.excerpt: Benefiting from the compact network design, NAF spends similar running time to iterative methods and is 3×faster than the frequency-encoding deep learning method IntraTomo3D.
